text:
Arjun: Heads-up — eu-west-1 GPU queue for rwd-7b-quant is exploding. Per-shard queue depth up ~6x in last 10m, p95 latency moved from ~1.8s to ~3.6s. Seeing timeouts and some 429s. Anyone on this?
SRE-Bot: ALERT: queue_depth_high | region=eu-west-1 | model=rwd-7b-quant | triggered_at=1763248740
Priya: oncall here, grabbing dashboards. Which specific pools and models are hot vs collateral?
Arjun: Primary hit is pool eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2, shards 0-7. Also some rwd-13b-qt on the same pool getting backing up. Quick dump:```
pool: eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2
capacity_gpus: 16
active_shards: 8
qdepth: 620 -> 3800 (10m)
avg_latency_p95: 1.8s -> 3.6s
errors: 2.3% timeout / 0.6% 429
```
Maya: any recent infra deploys or routing changes?
Arjun: no infra deploys in last hour. There were transient network errors to the KV caching layer at 08:06 but those look resolved. Traffic spike looks organic — maybe a campaign? @Nora?
Nora: yep, marketing pushed a EU campaign at 08:40 UTC, expected uptick in free-tier volume. Can we route non-pay traffic to fallback or smaller models temporarily? :sweat_smile:
Li: we can do admission control per-model and tighten per-key rate limits. Will test a 0.5x concurrency cap on a single shard to validate behavior.
Arjun: plan proposal: 1) apply per-model max_concurrency override (limit new arrivals) 2) tighten per-key rate-limits for free-tier 3) scale pool by +2 GPUs (emergency) 4) route free-tier -> rwd-3b-qt fallback. Cost note: +2 gpus ~€250/hr.
Mateo: ops approves emergency spend up to €1000 this week. Approve +2 GPUs for 2 hours.
Priya: I'll apply throttles now. Running:```
redwoodctl set-concurrency --model rwd-7b-quant --region eu-west-1 --value 4
redwoodctl set-rate-limit --scope free-tier --region eu-west-1 --limit 300r/s
```
SRE-Bot: command executed: set-concurrency success; set-rate-limit success; request_id=cmd-1763248798
Arjun: after applying these, queue depth dropped ~30% in 6m. Monitoring p95 and error rate.
Priya: I also added a header-based routing rule to send traffic with x-customer-tier=free to rwd-3b-qt in eu-west. Rolling to 10% then 50%.
Nora: thanks — I'll pause the campaign burst if it still looks bad in 15m.
Maya: good mitigation. Post-incident actions: add per-campaign forecast alerts (campaign-ID in telemetry), implement region spillover policy to send excess to eu-north or use hosted fallback, and add a predictive threshold to pre-scale dedicated pools before campaign launches.
Li: I'll file INFRA-4721 with the owners, the step-by-step mitigation, and cost estimates.
Arjun: also: short-term follow-up: evaluate splitting rwd-7b-quant across two pools to avoid noisy-neighbor saturation. Long-term: add admission controller that uses realtime qdepth + cost budget to auto-throttle by priority.
Mateo: acknowledged. Keep ops looped if we extend capacity beyond 2 hours.
Priya: final check — queues stable for now, p95 trending down to ~2.1s, errors <1%. I'll keep this thread open for 1h while we watch.
Arjun: thanks all. I'll assemble charts and cost impact for the incident writeup.
Mateo: 👍
Maya: please add retrospective notes to the ticket once charts are attached.
Li: added INFRA-4721 link to the thread once created.
Arjun: noted — closing triage. If we get another campaign, we'll run the pre-scale runbook.
